basic_details.short_information: Central Council for Research in Unani Medicine (CCRUM) Recruitment 2026 notification has been released under Advertisement No. 1/2026 on the official website. A total of 179 vacancies have been announced across Group A, Group B, and Group C posts through the CCRUM Recruitment 2026.

application_fee.details: Application fee is payable only through online payment gateway (Net Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI). All candidates, including fee-exempted categories, must pay the non-refundable Processing Fee. Bank charges plus GST are levied extra depending on the payment mode. Candidates applying for multiple posts must pay separate fees for each post.

age_limit.details: Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India rules: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC-NCL, 10 years for PwBD (UR), 13 years for PwBD (OBC-NCL), and 15 years for PwBD (SC/ST). Government servants get relaxation up to 5 years as per instructions. The maximum age limit after combining all cumulative age relaxations shall be 56 years. Age relaxation for reserved category candidates is admissible only against vacancies reserved for that category.

how_to_apply: Visit the official CCRUM website: www.ccrum.res.in or www.ccrum.ayush.gov.in and go to the "Advertisement/Vacancy" tab.

Step 1 - Create Account: Register using your full name, father's/mother's name, gender, date of birth, mobile number, e-mail ID, and a valid Government ID proof to generate a Login ID (Reference Number) and password.

Step 2 - Complete Profile: Log in and fill in personal details, category/sub-category, upload photograph, signature, caste/category certificate, PwBD certificate, and basic qualification certificates.
Step 3 - Apply for Post(s): Select the desired post, fill post-specific details, upload post-specific documents, and proceed to payment. This step can be repeated for each additional post.
Pay the applicable Processing Fee and Examination Fee online through Net Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI.
Download the duly filled application form and payment receipt from the Dashboard for future reference. Do not send it to CCRUM by post.
important_instructions: Only online applications through the official CCRUM website will be accepted; applications sent by post, e-mail, or any other mode will be rejected. Candidates should apply well before the closing date to avoid last-minute website load issues. Candidates can apply for more than one post, but must submit separate applications with separate fees for each post. Once an application is submitted, no edits are allowed except through the paid Modification Window (3-5 August 2026). Admit cards will be hosted only on the registration portal and will not be sent by post or e-mail. Calculators, mobile phones, smartwatches, and other electronic/communication devices are strictly banned inside the examination hall. Candidates must carry a valid photo ID and admit card to the examination centre; biometric data will be captured at the test centre. Test centres are located in New Delhi/Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, Mumbai, Hyderabad, and Guwahati; CCRUM reserves the right to add/remove/change centres. The posts carry All India transfer liability, and candidates must be willing to serve at any peripheral Institute/Centre of CCRUM. Selection is purely provisional, subject to verification of eligibility, documents, and character/antecedents.

Candidates looking for more research opportunities can also explore the latest Delhi Government Jobs across various departments. Applicants searching for openings in Ayush and healthcare can check Ministry of Ayush Jobs for upcoming vacancies. Those holding a postgraduate degree in science can also browse more M.Sc Government Jobs and Research Officer Jobs matching their qualification.

content_sections.heading: CCRUM Vacancy Details 2026 (Post-wise, incl. Reservation Break-up)
content_sections.text: 1 post of Research Officer (Pathology) is reserved for PwBD (Blind/Low Vision). 2 posts of Medical Laboratory Technologist (MLT) are reserved for PwBD (Deaf/Hearing Impaired and Locomotor Disability categories). 6 posts in Group C are reserved for PwBD candidates (2 each in UDC, LDC, and MTS). Ex-Servicemen (ESM) reservation applies to UDC (03), Stenographer Grade-III (01), LDC (02), and MTS (04). Note: Vacancies are subject to increase or decrease at the discretion of CCRUM. Vacancies notified include backlog vacancies of earlier recruitment years, so the 50% reservation stipulation may be exceeded for some posts.

content_sections.text: Group A Posts: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) of 70 marks followed by an Interview of 30 marks. Skill Test for Stenographer Grade-III: dictation at 80 wpm for 10 minutes (English/Hindi), transcribed on computer; qualifying in nature. Skill Test for LDC: typing speed of 35 wpm in English or 30 wpm in Hindi on computer; qualifying in nature. Driving Test for Staff Car Driver: qualifying in nature, as per Competent Authority procedures. CBT duration: 100 minutes for all candidates (130 minutes for PwBD candidates with compensatory time), for both Group A and Group B/C posts.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CCRUM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online and complete fee payment for CCRUM Recruitment 2026 is 31 July 2026 at 23:59 hrs. Candidates should not wait until the last day to avoid portal congestion.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CCRUM Bharti 2026?
faq.answer: CCRUM has notified 179 vacancies across 23 posts in Group A, B, and C categories under Advertisement No. 1/2026. Several of these vacancies are backlog positions from previous years.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for CCRUM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Age limits are set as per CCRUM norms. Candidates should refer to the official notification for post-wise age criteria and relaxation details.

faq.question: Q4. Is there negative marking in the CCRUM 2026 exam?
faq.answer: Yes. There is a 0.25 mark deduction for each wrong answer in the CBT for Group A, B, and C posts. However, for the MTS post, there is no negative marking.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for CCRUM Group A posts?
faq.answer: Group A selection involves an online CBT of 70 marks followed by an interview of 30 marks. Candidates are shortlisted for interview at a ratio of 1:5 (1 vacancy), 1:4 (2 vacancies), or 1:3 (3 or more vacancies).

faq.question: Q6. Where will the CCRUM 2026 exam be held?
faq.answer: The online CBT will be conducted at exam centers in New Delhi/Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, Mumbai, Hyderabad, and Guwahati. CCRUM reserves the right to add or cancel centers.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply for more than one post in CCRUM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates can apply for multiple posts using the same reference number/login. Each post requires a separate application and separate fee payment. Do not create multiple accounts.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for CCRUM Group A Research Officer posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for Research Officer posts is 40 years. Government servants are eligible for up to 5 years of age relaxation as per Central Government orders.

faq.question: Q9. What is the pay scale for MTS in CCRUM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) are placed at Pay Level-1 under the 7th CPC, with a pay range of ₹18,000 to ₹56,900. Selected candidates will be governed by the New Pension Scheme.
